fields.statement: QA at d34deebf1 with a binary built from the head (go build -trimpath): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestOrchestratorDocRules|TestOrchestratorConsultsOwner|TestAgentDocs' passes (TestAgentDocsConsistent and Fixtures pass with orchestrator.md indexed in agents/README.md). Exercised the commands the doc names: in a scratch git repo `rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 2` exits 0 and writes git config 2, `... abc` exits 2 with a whole-number error; `rhiza withdraw/accept/apply/link --help` all exist; `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` works as the fetch-free alternative; the ../AGENTS.md link resolves. In a clean detached worktree of the head, `rhiza check` prints ok (only pre-existing unclaimed warnings) and `rhiza render` leaves no diff.

QA at d34deebf1: read agents/orchestrator.md: 'Consult the owner first' requires a recommendation before any judgment call and autonomy only when the owner granted it for that task or session; 'When idle' says propose the next high-value work instead of starting it while queued bug requests still flow through plan-bug and bugfix. grep finds no 'Consult the owner' in AGENTS.md. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestOrchestratorConsultsOwner passes; rhiza check on a clean detached checkout of the head prints ok.
